name: nifty-expiry-iron-fly
title: NIFTY expiry-day iron fly
description: On a NIFTY weekly expiry day, sell the ATM straddle at the day's opening prices (strikes centred on the index's open) and buy wings 200 points away; hold to the 15:30 cash settlement. End-of-day data cannot see an intraday stop, so there is none: the wings are the risk limit.
